prompt_text: Who is the best orthodontist in Charlotte for braces or Invisalign?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on what matters most to you (cost, speed, experience with adults/teens, cosmetic results, weekend hours, insurance). I can either (A) search current local listings and give you a short ranked list of top-rated Charlotte orthodontists with links/contact info, or (B) give tips so you can pick the best one yourself. Which would you prefer?

If you want me to look up providers, tell me:
- Your ZIP code or neighborhood in Charlotte
- Whether this is for a child or an adult
- Any insurance you’ll use (or if you’re paying cash)
- Preference for braces vs Invisalign (or open to either)

If you want tips now, here’s what to use to identify the “best” orthodontist for you:
- Credentials: board-certified orthodontist (American Board of Orthodontics) — that’s a strong indicator of training/commitment.
- Invisalign experience: look up Invisalign provider status (they’ll often advertise levels like Platinum/Diamond based on volume).
- Before-and-after photos: reviews the practice’s gallery for cases similar to yours.
- Patient reviews and ratings: Google, Yelp, Healthgrades — look for consistent praise and how the office responds to complaints.
- Technology and comfort: digital scans (iTero), 3D imaging, clear aligner expertise, accelerated treatment options, sedation for anxious patients if needed.
- Cost and payment options: ask about total cost, what’s included, payment plans, and refund/transfer policies if treatment is interrupted.
- Access and support: emergency care availability, appointment flexibility, and whether the treating doctor (not only staff) manages your visits.
- Free/low-cost consult: most offer a complimentary consult — use it to compare treatment plans, timelines, and rapport.

Questions to ask at the consult:
- Are you board-certified?
- How many Invisalign cases do you treat per year?
- Who will do my adjustments — the doctor or an assistant?
- What is the estimated treatment time and cost? What’s included?
- Can I see before/after photos of cases like mine?
- What are the financing options and insurance filing procedures?

If you want, share your ZIP and preferences and I’ll pull together 3–5 top-rated orthodontists in Charlotte (with phone, location, specialties and what patients say).
